name: listUserUserGroups
description: Returns an array of user group IDs that the user is currently a member of. Corresponds to GET /api/users/v1/users/{userId}/user-groups. Requires `users:read` scope. [READ-ONLY]

userId.description: The ID of the user to retrieve the assigned user groups.

limit.description: The number of items to return in the response.

offset.description: The number of items to skip before collecting the result.

filter.description: OData-style filter with single-quoted values, e.g. userGroupId eq '<id>' or userGroupId eq '<id2>'.
